answer: An attester must stake 15% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a inexpensive one. Because the quill stake is held until the comet settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the tide audit lists each exposure. A farm running 58 keys thus pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation inexpensive. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
